message: 人間界の歩き方

name: Synn
message: 「Sigh... Tea really is delicious.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't you ever get tired of drinking nothing but tea?」

name: Synn
message: 「Tea tastes great, and it's good for your health too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah. That's just the kind of guy you are, isn't it.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Getting dragged along with you has turned my life completely healthy too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew... So good.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, hate to interrupt while you're relaxing, but where should we go to get the recycled goods?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. Ria-senpai and Misa already went to 'Ponpoko,' so...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And Lolo-chan went to 'Raffine'... so maybe 'Kindai Kosho'?」
Since we're familiar faces around the shopping district, we took on the task of recruiting new cooperating stores, however.

name: Nanaka
message: 「They're pretty stingy over there, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... In that case, maybe 'Shironekodo,' though I'm not too keen on it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, that place... Why aren't you keen on it? We used to play there all the time when we were little.」

name: Synn
message: 「There was that time you got stuck inside a pot and couldn't get out, Nanaka.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What a dummy, soba.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That was you, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right... Still, you were the one who broke that big jar, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, well, when I went to apologize later, turns out that jar was only 500 yen.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-Whaaat?! I-It was something that expensive?! That makes it even harder to show my face at that shop!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, I'm the one who broke it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, while you were playing with me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, Synn... Don't tell me you haven't been back to that shop since then?」

name: Synn
message: 「B-Because it was 500 yen! That's a fortune! I bet that old man still holds a grudge against you and me!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even I'm starting to feel like 500 yen is a fortune... That's not a good sign.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nah, I already went ahead and paid for that myself.」

name: Synn
message: 「...S-Such a huge sum of money! Y-You're amazing, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahaha...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Anyway, let's steel ourselves and head to 'Shironekodo'」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, it's Azel.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「All that Vandine Jelly... doesn't she ever get tired of it?」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't know supplements came in so many varieties...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So much of that gross stuff... just looking at it wears me out.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yours truly wants to gobble up Ria-chan nice and tasty.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Bingo!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be... that Azel only eats stuff like that?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「More like drinking than eating. Judging by that amount, looks like it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe she's short on cash. In that case, as Student Council President, I should--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're just as broke as she is.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... being broke sure is depressing...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「By the way, how much money do you have on you right now?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way!? That's more than I thought.」

name: Synn
message: 「Checking the coin return slots on vending machines is for amateurs. Dropped coins usually roll underneath the machine.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, don't go flexing such depressing trivia. It's gonna make me cry.」

name: Synn
message: 「Stuff like that is cheaper at the shopping district supermarket than here, right? Pretty sure it's even on sale today.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why don't you go tell her?」

name: Synn
message: 「Mhm. If it's practical everyday trivia like this, Azel will definitely be happy to listen!」
We stood up from our seats and called out to Azel as she walked away from the register.

name: Synn
message: 「Hello.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heya!」
Tap, tap, tap.
Whoa, completely ignored!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Impregnable as ever, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you try talking to her too, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nope. I already gave up.」

name: Synn
message: 「So fast.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm a true Edoite, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Azel. Do you buy that all the time?」

name: Synn
message: 「If you're buying that, there's a much cheaper store in the shopping district.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Cheaper?」
Azel's footsteps stopped dead in their tracks.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Probably about 10 yen cheaper per piece.」

name: Synn
message: 「To be exact, it's 12 yen.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So nitpicky.」

name: Azel
message: 「What is a shopping district?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaat?! You don't know?! Even if it's a pretty obscure shopping district, that's just cruel. We're practically going out of business over here.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're exaggerating, Nanaka...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaaaaaaaaaaat?!?! You bought it, Synn?! No way!」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena was the one who bought it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aha, gotcha. Ria-senpai's family is rich, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, have you worn those clothes from the other day since then?」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't need it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lucky. If you don't want the clothes, I'll take 'em!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's with that silence.」

name: Synn
message: 「It comes with cat ears, cat paws, and even a tail, you know.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-So Helena's into that kind of thing...」

name: Synn
message: 「Looked to me like she was just having a laugh, though. Besides...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, uh, you know. How should I put it, the volume or whatever...」
Nanaka glanced briefly at Azel's chest.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah. ...S-Sorry. There's no way I could wear that.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why apologize?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jeez, Synn! Don't embarrass me like that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why the heck am I the one gettin' smacked for it!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A comedic slap?」
And so, pulling a rattling handcart along, the three of us headed over to the shopping street together.

name: Nanaka
message: 「This area centered around this road is Ryuusei Shopping Street.」

name: Synn
message: 「Stuff's cheap, some places will haggle down the price, and the shopkeepers are all friendly--it's a great shopping street.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not that it's a particularly special shopping street or anything, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「What's a 'special shopping street' supposed to be like?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know, like *that*. Where buildings so tall you'd faint just looking up at them stretch on and on? Hmm, guess that wouldn't be a shopping street at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Not bad, delivering your own punchline like that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I mean, that really wouldn't be a shopping street, would it.」

name: Synn
message: 「True.」

name: Azel
message: 「Vandine Jelly.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We're almost there.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, right. We're collecting recycled goods for the upcoming KiraFes--do you happen to know anywhere that might be willing to donate some?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's impossible. She's a transfer student, after all. She's probably short on furniture and things herself.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, right. Well, in that case, if there's anything you need, you might be able to get it at KiraFes.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Hey, if it isn't Synn and the Miss.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey there--」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Well now, there's a girl I haven't seen around here before.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um, this is Azel. A mysterious transfer student.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Hey there, Azel-chan. I'm Shinsuke Tamekage, and I run a shop called 'Ponpoko' here in this shopping district. Give us your business if you can.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Kuha. Well, that got me. Is Azel-chan one of those trendy tsunderes?」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Or maybe a kuudere?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's that?」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Well, ever since I started stocking figures, y'know, I've picked up all that kind of lingo.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Still, though. Synn sure has a wandering eye--must be tough on you, Miss.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Tame-san
message: 「I mean another rival has appeared, hasn't she? She's quite the cutie, too. Wasn't satisfied with just you, Miss, so he went and made the Student Council, and now this--boy, oh boy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why do people around here immediately jump to that conclusion?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Probably because they have too much time on their hands?」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Ouch, you're harsh, Miss.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Listen up, Synn. No need to be shy about it. I was the exact same way when I was young. Truth be told, I was super popular with the ladies.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...No way.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Putting me aside, Miss, don't you think Synn's got the kind of face that'd be popular? If I were a girl his age, I wouldn't leave him alone.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's a subtly disturbing hypothetical scenario, you know.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Gahahahaha.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It'll be fine. Look, Synn's never been popular with girls up till now, so from here on out too, he definitely, surely... maybe, probably... won't be popular, I think.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Yeah, but the Student Council's packed with girls, ain't it? Wouldn't be weird if at least one of 'em fell head over heels for Synn.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh... no, no way, that wouldn't.」

name: Synn
message: 「Listen. I have no intention of bringing any impure elements like that into Student Council activities!」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Once love starts, there ain't no stopping it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Y-You've got a point.」

name: Misa
message: 「Shoplifter!」

name: Ria
message: 「They should've gone this way... Excuse me, hello, did a shoplifter happen to come past here?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, we didn't see anyone... wait, Ria-senpai!」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, Synn-kun. Nanaka-chan.」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you slacking off from work and chatting for?!」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Hey, by shoplifting, don't tell me.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, Tamekage-san. Yes, it's just what you're thinking.」

name: Misa
message: 「A Demon flew in and cleared out a whole bunch of toys. Sorry.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Don't sweat it. I'm the one who dumped shop-sitting on you, after all. Besides, if it was stuff sitting outside, it was all freebies anyway.」

name: Ria
message: 「I managed to get a picture of the Demon, though. They got away.」
When I looked at the cell phone Ria-senpai held out to me.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yep, that's a bona fide Demon alright.」

name: Synn
message: 「No doubt about it.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Oh, aren't these the guys who've been dining and dashing around the shopping district lately?」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that right?」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Yeah, they just leave behind some weird junk and don't pay a cent.」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, where could they have gone? It looked like they ran off somewhere around here...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aah!」

name: Synn
message: 「Our handcart!」

name: Misa
message: 「They're fast. Scurrying around like that is so cowardly.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, you don't see thieves running away slowly, right.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's true. Makes sense.」

name: Misa
message: 「Why are even you acting so laid-back, Sister!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, it's time for the Crusaders! Let's go after them.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right! You're always so slow on the uptake.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine. The way they ran has a lot of alleys, so if we corner them right, they'll be trapped like rats in a sack... Nanaka and I will go this way, and Misa and Ria-senpai will go that way.」

name: Ria
message: 「So calm, good job, good job. That's our Student Council President for you.」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph. Even I could have thought of that much.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wonder about that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Where's Azel?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? Well, right now we've gotta get the Demons!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Misa
message: 「You have nowhere left to run. Give yourselves up!」

name: Mochimochi
message: 「Eek!」

name: Synn
message: 「He says he's in a pinch.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What nerve for a thief! You deserve what's coming to you!」

name: Ria
message: 「Watch out!」
A Demon comes from behind!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, Lolo-chan!」
And just when we thought that, Lolotte appears from right behind him!

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady, down this alley.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Demon over there, return the toys I collected.」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte-san!」

name: Ria
message: 「My, even Lolotte-chan is here.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What a slick way to make an entrance.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because I am the headliner.」

name: Misa
message: 「There are two of them now, but there are four of us, so this'll be a piece of cake.」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't let your guard down. There's a huge gap between looking like you can win and actually winning, you know.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, Onee-sama.\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're only ever obedient to Ria-senpai, huh.」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-That's not true at all.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I won't hand over Ria-chan.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Purunah!?」

name: Girl
message: 「Don't pick on my buddy!」
Looking up, a girl and a demon are descending from the sky?

name: Synn
message: 「A human coming down from the sky--that's impossible!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, no matter how you look at it, she's a demon too. That girl.」

name: Ria
message: 「She has wings, after all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Having wings doesn't necessarily mean someone is a demon! Angels have wings too.

name: Lolotte
message: Awawa, I don't have any wings or anything!」
Still, it feels like I've had them before....

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone! Humanoid demons are powerful!」

name: Sally
message: 「Yah! Sally-chan has arrived!」
Lightly, the girl lands on the ground.

name: Misa
message: 「You're an accomplice of the shoplifter too!」

name: Sally
message: 「Calling us shoplifters is so rude! We're not some evil gang like that. We've got a super cool and sensitive organization name!」

name: Ria
message: 「Could you tell us, if you don't mind? And your name, too.」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm so glad you asked. I'm 'Sally-chan'!」

name: Sally
message: 「And as for my merry companions!」

name: Sally
message: 「Mochimochi!」

name: Mochimochi
message: 「Eek!」

name: Sally
message: 「Jangara!」

name: Jangara
message: 「Eee!」

name: Sally
message: 「Tinun!」

name: Tinun
message: 「Eee!」

name: Sally
message: 「And altogether, we're--」

name: Sally
message: 「The Delicious Food Squad♪」

name: Misa
message: 「That's a pretty stupid name for a gang of shoplifters.」

name: Sally
message: 「We're not a gang of shoplifters!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, it sounds like that guy over there was shoplifting.」

name: Sally
message: 「No way!」

name: Ria
message: 「Actually, we even have a photo as proof.」

name: Sally
message: 「Come on, there's no way... Wait, it's true!」

name: Sally
message: 「Mochimochi!」

name: Sally
message: 「Just because you ran out of Demon World Mail-Order goods doesn't mean you can swipe stuff without trading anything in return!」

name: Mochimochi
message: 「Eee.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Looks like the shoplifter's getting chewed out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure does.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even demons can feel remorse, huh. That's a surprise.」

name: Ria
message: 「They're actually decent people.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sister, don't let them fool you! No matter how remorseful they seem, they're still demons!」

name: Sally
message: 「You can't go tarnishing the Delicious Food Squad's good name! If you want food, you have to barter for it fair and square.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bartering... That means you didn't pay any money!」

name: Sally
message: 「Always paying in goods with a big smile is the Delicious Food Squad's motto!」

name: Misa
message: 「...Demons will be demons, I suppose.」

name: Synn
message: 「Listen, Sally-chan. If you take food without paying money for it, that's still no different from shoplifting.」

name: Sally
message: 「What's 'money'?」

name: Ria
message: 「So the Demon World runs on a barter system...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Small fry like them rarely get to come over here, so they don't understand what a monetary economy is.」

name: Sally
message: 「Grrr! I'm not small fry! I'm the Boss's number-one underling! The one and only renowned Sally de Genocide (rest omitted)!」

name: Sally
message: 「There's no such thing as small fry with a name this magnificent!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's less 'magnificent' and more just 'long'!」

name: Sally
message: 「Don't mock my name! After I went through the trouble of saying my full name, too--now I'm mad!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, hey! You're getting mad at us even though you're the one in the wrong!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So this is what they call 'stroking the dragon's reverse scale,' yes?」

name: Ria
message: 「Lolotte-chan. I can't quite explain why, but you're using that phrase wrong.」

name: Misa
message: 「Even though she's always like this, you still take the time to properly correct her... Big Sister, you are truly admirable.」

name: Mochimochi
message: 「Eee!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hm? What's wrong?」

name: Sally
message: 「Whaaat?! Could you guys be the 'Stoo-dent Cown-sil' Mochimochi was talking about?! That heinous, violent, shameless gang?!」

name: Synn
message: 「We're the Student Council, yes, but we're not a heinous, violent gang! And calling us 'shameless' is a total false accusation!」

name: Misa
message: 「The only shameless one here is Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's a false accusation too!」

name: Sally
message: 「So you're pals with the jerks who bullied Mochimochi and the others!」

name: Ria
message: 「We didn't bully them, that kid was--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, the dine-and-dashers from back then! We won't let you get away this time!」

name: Sally
message: 「That's my line! I'm gonna beat you black and blue!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Eee!」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't lose either!」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady, I, Riesling Tooyama, shall lend you my aid.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thanks, Jiiya!」

name: Misa
message: 「B-But this isn't something an amateur can just join in on.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no matter how you look at it, this guy is definitely not an amateur...」
